// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/model-prompts: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface InstructedPrompt {
    readonly instruction: InstructionPrompt;
    readonly data: string;
}

export interface InstructionPrompt {
    readonly owner_id: string;
    readonly prompt_id: string;
    readonly version: number;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly purpose: string;
    readonly used_by: readonly string[];
    readonly body: string;
}

export type ModelPromptInput = string | InstructedPrompt;

export declare function composeInstructedPrompt(body: string, data: string): string;

export declare function defineInstructionPrompt(prompt: InstructionPrompt): InstructionPrompt;

export declare function instructed(instruction: InstructionPrompt, data: string): InstructedPrompt;

export declare function isInstructedPrompt(value: unknown): value is InstructedPrompt;

export declare function modelPromptText(prompt: ModelPromptInput): string;
